title: Quenched Croatian Pork Pastrmajlija
description: Fermented, crumbly Croatian dish featuring ground annatto, steamed in a leaf wrap to perfection. Great for midnight cravings.

ingredients.name: Annatto seeds
ingredients.notes: Grind the annatto seeds to a fine powder

ingredients.name: Leaf wraps ( collard green or beet leaf )

instructions: Mix the ground pork, annatto powder, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, and thyme in a large bowl.
Knead the mixture for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and even.
Cut the leaf wraps into large pieces, about 10x10 inches.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each leaf piece.
Fold the leaf over the pork mixture to form a triangle, and secure with a toothpick.
Place the wrapped pork mixture in a steamer basket, and steam for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the pork mixture from the steamer, and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the pastrmajlija warm, with additional annatto powder sprinkled on top if desired.
